description: Akashneelesh's method on ecdsa.fail (17 rows, Jun-Nov 2026; Q765 from 128.7M to 48.4M Toffoli in 37 hours): take a cheaper public walk a few qubits wider and buy the qubits back with a page of low bits whose fourth word is implicit in the walk's invariant, narrow end machines shipped as checked gate lists, a staged build where switch-off rebuilds the parent, and a census failure budget. Use when a public walk k qubits wider costs a fraction of your line; when a two-ring Euclid walk must lose wires; when a stream is assembled from modules built by separate agents; when summing a failure budget term by term; or when you review a row built this way.
